status: Frozen evaluation plan; not publication approval
purpose: Evaluate unchanged candidate-and-uncertainty partial-count method across Senate and governor races before broadening production scope
selection: First indexed capture per URL from November 9 through November 10, 2022, including every indexed eligible race; no outcome, margin or winner-based selection
forecastSource: Latest available pre-election archived 2022 deluxe toplines; independently check date, byte checksum, candidate identities and uncertainty

fixedModel.parameters: No fitting or hyperparameter changes on this evaluation cohort

scope: Conditional D/R plurality component only. This does not authorize multicandidate win vectors or ranked-choice/runoff/legislative contingency races
report: All accepted and quarantined races with explicit reasons
New races separately from previously inspected races
Source-estimated reporting stages below 25 and at least 25 separately
Equal-state Brier/log loss and 80% margin interval coverage
Paired state bootstrap versus frozen prior
Prior-competitive subgroup with absolute frozen margin at most 10 points
publication: A model does not become validated merely because data were collected. Require demonstrated held-out skill and adequate uncertainty before expanding live scope.
